backgroundPermissionRationale.title: StillHere needs background location
backgroundPermissionRationale.message: StillHere monitors your safety even when the app is in the background. This ensures your emergency contacts can locate you if needed.

infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: StillHere uses your location in the background to keep you safe. If you miss a check-in or need help, we can alert your trusted contacts with your location so they can reach you quickly.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: StillHere uses your location during check-ins, safety features, and maps so you and your trusted contacts can see where help may be needed.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Background location lets StillHere watch over you even when your phone is locked. This way, your trusted contacts are always just a tap away if something happens.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: StillHere uses motion sensors to detect possible falls or vehicle crashes and automatically alert your emergency contacts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: StillHere uses your microphone for voice calls with your trusted contacts so you can speak directly during a check-in or emergency.
